description: Source code for the link quality management module, including class 'linkq_t' with methods for running algorithms, managing connection quality metrics, and handling connection state, specific to Wi-Fi link quality assessment.

classes.name: linkq_t
classes.description: Class managing Wi-Fi link quality metrics, including score calculation, connection state, and alarm triggering.

methods.name: run_algorithm
methods.description: Calculates link quality scores based on normalized metrics, updates internal state, and triggers callbacks if thresholds are crossed.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Simulates or tests link quality metrics, managing connection state and invoking the main algorithm.

methods.name: update_window_per
methods.description: Updates the percentage window metrics for downlink and uplink based on recent packet counts.

methods.name: get_window_samples
methods.description: Retrieves recent samples of link quality metrics.

methods.name: reinit
methods.description: Reinitializes the link quality manager with new parameters.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the link quality manager with thresholds, reporting interval, and initial stats.

methods.name: rapid_disconnect
methods.description: Marks the link as disconnected to simulate or handle rapid disconnect scenarios.

methods.name: set_quality_flags
methods.description: Sets the quality metrics to monitor.

methods.name: register_station_mac
methods.description: Registers a specific station MAC address for special handling.
